description: This file defines a React functional component named UsersList that renders a user list with filtering, searching, and pagination features. It imports UI components and an API client, manages state for user data, filters, and UI interactions, and renders a data table with user information such as Name, Tenant Id, Mail, and Department.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches all users from the API and updates the component state with the retrieved data.

methods.name: resetFilters
methods.description: Resets search query and organization filter to show the full user list.

methods.name: handleRowClick
methods.description: Handles row click events, delegating to parent callbacks if provided.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Sets the user row to be deleted (stub for delete action).
